pii_lead: One rule per entity: each one turns on and off by itself, and the change is written by patch to .jgates/pii.yml, leaving the rest of the file alone.
pii_file_new: The file does not exist yet; it is created on the first change.
pii_unsupported_hint: There is no tested detector for this entity yet.
pii_locale_hint: The built-in detector only recognizes the pt-BR format.
pii_check_digits_hint: Keeps only CPF, CNPJ and card numbers whose digits (or Luhn sum) check out. When off, any number with the format shows up.
pii_redact_hint: Always on: the built-in detector never stores or shows the raw value, not in logs, reports or the API.
pii_remediation_hint: Detecting, blocking, masking and fixing are separate things. This detector only observes: no file is changed by an analysis.
pii_conflict: pii.yml changed since the screen read it. Reload and redo the change.
pii_invalid_file: pii.yml has problems; fix it before changing it here (jgates config validate).
